wires-dark-board: A wire of both is drawn with an arrowhead at each end; before, any arrow drew one, at the end.
wires-both: The selected wire of both has two arrowheads and a glow over both, and its bar has the arrow picker in place of the Arrow button, with Flip off.
wires-dark-both: The selected wire of both has two arrowheads and a glow over both, and its bar has the arrow picker in place of the Arrow button, with Flip off.
